name: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Implement QAOA (p=2) from scratch in Qiskit t
task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Implement QAOA (p=2) from scratch in Qiskit to solve MaxCut on the graph with edges [(0, 1), (0, 2), (0, 3), (2, 3)]. Build the cost and mixer layers manually, optimize with scipy, and print the best cut found. Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
